Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.17

- Successful Sniper scans now appear as Complete in Status when failed batches and unresolved items are both zero.
- The minimum-profit filter now applies to 1-gil alerts too. Alerts without a known profit estimate remain hidden while this filter is enabled.
